About this demo

A condensed portfolio view of Mission-Board’s Overview, Needs Attention, project status, tasks, and update history. Escalation is recorded by people in notes and next actions. This is sample data, with no automated escalation or approval workflow. Filters and detail navigation work; editing is unavailable.
